name: PessimisticOfflineLock
summary: A conflict between two long transactions is prevented, by letting only one of them hold the data.

roles.name: PessimisticOfflineLock
roles.summary: A lock taken before the work begins and held across requests. It suits a system where a conflict is expensive to discover late, and it brings the problems a database transaction was hiding: a lock held by a user who went home, and therefore a timeout, an owner and a way to break it.
